meta.title: Wetherspoons Belfast: pubs, menus and prices guide
meta.description: Find Wetherspoons Belfast pubs, compare typical menu prices and check breakfast and club days. See which listings are in Belfast and which are in Newtownards.

intro: This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Belfast across {areaCount} areas, including Newtownards rather than Belfast alone. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. Use it to choose between The Bridge House and The Central Bar in the City Centre, or The Spirit Merchant in Newtownards. It also explains typical menu pricing, breakfast service and club days, with practical checks to make before choosing where to eat.
quickAnswer: We list {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs across Belfast and Newtownards, not all within Belfast itself. The Bridge House on Bedford Street and The Central Bar in Bankmore Square are the Belfast City Centre options. The Spirit Merchant is on Regent Street in Newtownards. These listings span {areaCount} areas, so check the location before choosing a pub.

areas.text: The Bridge House and The Central Bar are the listed Belfast City Centre pubs. Choose The Bridge House if Bedford Street suits your plans, or The Central Bar for Bankmore Square. Both belong on your shortlist if you want a Belfast address rather than the separate Newtownards listing.

The Spirit Merchant is the listed Wetherspoons option in Newtownards, on Regent Street. It suits readers looking specifically for a pub in Newtownards rather than Belfast City Centre. Keep that distinction in mind when comparing locations: its inclusion in this guide does not make it a Belfast city centre pub.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Belfast are set pub by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. Traditional [breakfast](/breakfast-menu), [burgers](/burgers), curries, fish and chips and pizza are popular national menu choices, but check the selected pub's menu before settling on an order.

City centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs. That is a general pattern, not proof that either Belfast City Centre listing costs more than The Spirit Merchant. Individual pub pricing matters more than assuming a single Belfast rate.

Treat any guide price as typical and variable by pub. For the exact price of your intended meal, check the menu at the pub or select the correct location in the Wetherspoon app before ordering.
breakfastAndClubs:
Wetherspoons breakfast is typically served from eight in the morning until noon, while [Steak Club](/steak-club) traditionally falls on Tuesday and [Curry Club](/curry-club) on Thursday at participating pubs. These are general patterns to check with your chosen Belfast or Newtownards pub, not confirmed service details for every listing.

Traditional breakfast is among the popular dishes on the national menu. If breakfast is the reason for your visit, confirm service times before setting off. For either club, ask whether the pub participates and check the current menu and typical prices rather than assuming every location offers the same choice.

tips.title: Check the location
tips.text: Choose between Belfast City Centre and Newtownards before comparing pubs. The Spirit Merchant is in Newtownards, while The Bridge House and The Central Bar are the Belfast listings.

tips.title: Compare the same meal
tips.text: Check the same dish at each pub when comparing typical prices. A broadly shared national menu does not mean The Bridge House, The Central Bar and The Spirit Merchant charge alike.

tips.title: Confirm breakfast service
tips.text: Ask your chosen pub to confirm breakfast service if you are planning around it. The typical national window runs from eight in the morning until noon.

tips.title: Check club participation
tips.text: Confirm that your selected pub participates before planning a club meal. Steak Club traditionally runs on Tuesday, with Curry Club on Thursday, but participation needs checking.

tips.title: Choose how to order
tips.text: Order at the bar or at your table using the Wetherspoon app. If using the app, check that you have selected the intended pub before placing your order.

faqs.question: How many Wetherspoons are in Belfast?
faqs.answer: This guide lists The Bridge House and The Central Bar in Belfast itself, plus The Spirit Merchant in Newtownards. The total of {pubCount} open pubs therefore covers Belfast and Newtownards together, not Belfast alone. Check the area attached to each listing when deciding where to go.

faqs.question: Which Wetherspoons in Belfast are in the city centre?
faqs.answer: The Bridge House and The Central Bar are the listed Belfast City Centre Wetherspoons pubs. You will find The Bridge House on Bedford Street and The Central Bar in Bankmore Square. Choose according to the location that suits your plans, then check that pub's current menu and typical prices.

faqs.question: Is The Spirit Merchant in Belfast?
faqs.answer: The Spirit Merchant is in Newtownards, not Belfast City Centre. Its listed location is Regent Street, Newtownards, and it appears in this guide alongside the Belfast pubs. If you want a Belfast City Centre location, compare The Bridge House on Bedford Street with The Central Bar in Bankmore Square instead.

faqs.question: What time does breakfast start at Wetherspoons in Belfast?
faqs.answer: Breakfast at Wetherspoons typically starts at eight in the morning and runs until noon. That is the general service window, not a confirmed breakfast timetable for each Belfast pub. Check directly with The Bridge House or The Central Bar if your visit depends on breakfast being served at a particular time.

faqs.question: Are prices higher at Wetherspoons in Belfast?
faqs.answer: Belfast prices are set by each pub, so there is no single citywide Wetherspoons rate. City centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs, but that does not establish a price ranking between these listings. Compare the same meal on each pub's current menu and treat guide prices as typical.

faqs.question: What days are Curry Club and Steak Club in Belfast?
faqs.answer: Curry Club is traditionally on Thursday and Steak Club on Tuesday at participating Wetherspoons pubs. Participation at individual Belfast locations needs checking rather than assuming. Ask The Bridge House or The Central Bar about the current club menu and typical prices before planning your visit around either day.

faqs.question: Can I order through the Wetherspoon app in Belfast?
faqs.answer: Customers can order at their table using the Wetherspoon app, or order at the bar. For a Belfast visit, make sure the selected location is The Bridge House or The Central Bar, as intended. Check your chosen pub's menu and price before submitting the order rather than relying on another location's listing.
